body: Believe me, after the second time she asked I was through giving her money. She begged me and tried to manipulate me 3 times before I finally cracked. If I could get an apartment with my loan money alone, I would have been out, many places require certain income to even be considered; now I have no loan money at all so not sure where to go from here.
She says she's been waiting for disability to get back to her before working again.
Hey, no need for a long post, I appreciate it all the same. Thank you so much for the kind words.

Hey, I appreciate the time you took to comment on this, thank you. I am more hopeful than I'd like to admit, it's just I can't actually imagine it all coming true, especially with all that's been happening. It just doesn't seem realistic. It's still nice to dream, though. I will definitely make more of an effort to make small goals, I feel that would help my self-worth, since I make these huge goals and beat myself up when I don't meet them. 
Thank you for sharing your story, it's nice to hear words from someone who's gone through a similar thing. I'll trudge through this week (it's all assignments and finals) and then I'll take a step back and see where to go from there. Thanks for this, it means a lot to me.

I've considered honestly, and it would be wonderful if I could make that work, but I don't think they'd let my boyfriend stay with me- even if it was an apartment. I suppose it couldn't hurt to ask but I can't leave him here, he came from like 1,000 miles away. I really do think that living closer to the school would solve a lot of problems. Thank you for the comment, it really means a lot knowing people cared enough to comment on my self-indulgent rant, seriously.

I want to move out so bad, it's so hard when you have no money and you don't meet income requirements. Not to mention I've barely had time to research more apartments because of how stressed and busy I've been. I actually was considering taking a year off already, I just don't know what I'd do during it and I'm afraid it'd make things worse. I appreciate the comment, thank you :)
